about: Values read by hand from documents in this directory that cannot be extracted by script (PDF). Each entry names the file, its SHA-256, the page and the sentence it was read from. `npm run reference` checks the file against the hash and copies the values into reference.json.

triple point of water.quote: the best estimate of the value of TTPW remains 273.16 K. [...] The standard uncertainty of TTPW is hence now u(TTPW) = 0.1 mK.
